speaker: Mithali Raj
quote_text:
You talked there about some of the younger players coming through. What does the future of this team look like and what does the future hold for the team?

Mithali: I think the future definitely is very bright looking at Richa, Yastika and we have  of course, Sneha Rana - she made a comeback, we have Meghna who's in the stand by and these girls will definitely play in the coming years good standard of cricket and the way they get the exposure of playing different leagues and playing regularly with the best of the best in the world. I'm sure the team will shape up well for the future tournaments.

I know it's so hard when it's so fresh, but could you just explain to us your emotions at this moment because obviously Jhulan missed out on playing the game, but both of you are - as long as you mentioned, you've had long and illustrious careers. But yeah, they've come to an end and can you sum up your emotions at the moment?

Mithali: Honestly, right now I don't have any emotions, I'm just trying to get the hang of how the match has gone through, preparing myself to answer your questions. Probably  it will hit me maybe tomorrow, because at some point we'll have to deal with the disappointment, it's a process - it will take time.
